about:
AMBAC International, based in Elgin, South Carolina, traces its roots to 1910 when it began as American Bosch, manufacturing heavy-duty engine components in the United States. The company is employee-owned, operating under an open-book leadership model that shares financial transparency with its workforce.

The company specializes in precision machining, grinding, and honing, holding micron-level tolerances for low- to medium-volume production. Its services span manufacturing and remanufacturing of complex mechanical assemblies, including reverse engineering, product design, heat treatment, and assembly with test. Production volumes range from 100 to 50,000 estimated annual units, with a work envelope of 0.25 to 18 inches and diameters up to approximately 6 inches.

AMBAC serves aerospace, defense, and industrial original equipment manufacturers, as well as remanufacturing distributors. Its core focus is power and fluid components such as camshafts, valves, pumps, and injectors for high-pressure fluid flow and powertrain applications.

The firm differentiates itself through its century-long legacy, employee ownership culture, and relationship-based approach that emphasizes personalized service and technical depth in engineering and metallurgy.
